say:2:1041566901:1.text: This stick is getting a bit old.

say:3:1041566902:1.text: Let's see... Yes, the tip is a tad frayed. Any more pressure here and it would break.
say:3:1041566902:1.source_cn: 我看看……确实，顶端磨损得有些厉害，这里再用力就会断了。

say:4:1041566903:1.text: Did you make this staff yourself?
say:4:1041566903:1.source_cn: 这是你自己处理的木棍吗？

say:5:1041566904:1.text: Yeah, I found one that I liked, polished it, and then I was on my way.
say:5:1041566904:1.source_cn: 嗯，恰好捡了一根顺手的，打磨了下就直接用了。

say:6:1041566905:1.text: Desert trees grow slower, so their wood is less dense. Add the arid climate, and it becomes brittle over time. Not ideal for durability.
say:6:1041566905:1.source_cn: 沙漠里的树，木质普遍疏松些，加上气候干燥，韧性就差点。

say:7:1041566906:1.text: I'll share some of my maintenance oil with you. Treat it like I'll show you, and it'll last a bit longer.
say:7:1041566906:1.source_cn: 我分你一些保养油，你再捡到木棍，照我说的预处理一次，就...

say:8:1041566907:1.text: Your staff looks sturdy and flexible.
say:8:1041566907:1.source_cn: 你用的这根……木棍，看起来就很顺手。

say:9:1041566908:1.text: This is bamboo, a common plant in my hometown. It now grows here as well.
say:9:1041566908:1.source_cn: 这是竹子，我故乡常见的植物，如今在这边也有种植了。

say:10:1041566909:1.text: Its advantage is that if you find the right place, then it grows lightning-fast. Its disadvantage is that it's hard to find the right place.
say:10:1041566909:1.source_cn: 优点是只要找到合适的地方，那它长得快又易得，缺点就是很...

say:11:1041566910:1.text: Would you like to try it? It's hollow and has a different center of gravity than what you're used to.
say:11:1041566910:1.source_cn: 你要试试吗？它是中空的，和你平时用的重心不同。

say:12:1041566911:1.text: Yes, thank you... Hmm... It feels very different.
say:12:1041566911:1.source_cn: 我试试……嗯，很特别的手感。

say:13:1041566912:1.text: I made this one to my height and grip. The length and thickness are not right for you.
say:13:1041566912:1.source_cn: 这根是我按自己的身高和握持方式打磨的，长度和粗细都不适合你。

say:14:1041566913:1.text: Next time I come, I'll bring you one that suits you.
say:14:1041566913:1.source_cn: 下次我过来，给你带一根适合你的吧。

say:15:1041566914:1.text: Thanks. I'll take it as a gift.
